capabilities: Generate AI content at the cursor from configured prompt commands
Configure and switch between multiple named LLM connections (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible)
Expand wikilinks and embedded files into the prompt context
Filter prompt content by callout types, link patterns, and custom filter functions
Maintain continuous conversations with per-note prompt-file overrides
disambiguation: Not a visual prompt-workflow builder; it generates AI content in notes from configured prompt commands.
extras: Also installable via BRAT; the directory listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Includes detailed troubleshooting, privacy section (no telemetry), and an external filter API for CustomJS and other plugins.
motivation: The author built it based on Thomas Chang's LLM journaling reflection plugin tutorial, extending the approach with multiple connections, prompt files, and filtering.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate AI content from reusable custom prompts using a local LLM or configurable external providers.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on Build an LLM Journaling Reflection Plugin for Obsidian by Thomas Chang
relations.plugin: Build an LLM Journaling Reflection Plugin for Obsidian (Thomas Chang)

relations.evidence: Additional implementation ideas come from the Canvas Conversation plugin by André Baltazar

summary: AI content generation plugin that runs commands from configured prompts against local Ollama models or OpenAI-compatible APIs and inserts the response at the cursor.
